audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose is generic 'EVEN' while the data (56.36% over 1934 games) and every content-layer why describe Hwei controlling the lane; the full-layer level chart reads 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer reads 'Hwei' on all seven.
audit.why: Hwei's QQ paints from outside Radiant Volley's 950 range; Mel has no dash and her only lockdown is Solar Snare (1000 range, 11s at rank 1). Her one true answer, Rebuttal, is 38s at rank 1 and 26s at rank 5 — far longer than Hwei's 6-10s QQ.
audit.corrected: Level chart moved to Hwei on all seven rows to match the content layer and the packet chart; difficulty prose grounded in Rebuttal's cooldown rather than 'setup spell'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text never names a Mel ability and calls Golden Eclipse a 'reflect' ultimate — the reflect is Rebuttal (W), not the R.
audit.why: Golden Eclipse (R) is a 25000-range global that strikes everyone carrying Overwhelm stacks and scales with stack count; it is not defensive at all. Rebuttal (W) is the reflect.
audit.corrected: Spike lines rewritten to name Golden Eclipse and Rebuttal correctly and to key Hwei's own spikes (Lost Chapter, level 6 R, Blackfire) against Rebuttal's 26-38s window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is stated vaguely ('reflects your projectiles back') and no Mel ability except Rebuttal is ever named. The execute on Searing Brilliance and the Overwhelm-stack scaling on Golden Eclipse are absent entirely.
audit.why: Every damaging Hwei spell — QQ, QW, QE, E paints and R — carries the projectile flag, so Rebuttal blanks the entire kit and sends it back. Searing Brilliance stacks Overwhelm on every ability and attack and executes at a threshold; Golden Eclipse then hits globally for more damage per stack, meaning the stacks Hwei eats in lane follow him to every fight.
audit.corrected: cooldowns, tldr, tradeBad, dosFull/dontsFull and report[5] now name Rebuttal (38s/26s), Solar Snare (11s), Radiant Volley (950) and Golden Eclipse (global, Overwhelm-scaled).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) and repeated 'fifteen-second' for Rebuttal, which is wrong at every rank.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26 seconds. Fifteen is not a rank value.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, winCon, dosFull[2].d and report[5].t.

edits.before: With a full combo damage lead compounding from your first item onward, you continue to outclass her at every range in skirmishes and teamfights. Overall this is one of your most comfortable mid lane matchups from start to finish.
